title: Media Inquiry — Channel 4 News Follow-Up

fields.message: Hi, this is Amanda from Channel 4 News. We’re preparing a live segment on the Millbrook water crisis. The advisory has been out for 1 hour. What’s the status? Is the plant back on automatic? Why are you running manual? And when will it be safe to drink again? Follow-up: We’re getting calls from people in Zone 2 saying they’re starting to taste something. Is it spreading?
fields.deadline: Going LIVE at 11:45 — NEED STATEMENT NOW!

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to confirm the manual operation status and address public concerns about zone spread. Watch for overcommitment to timelines or unapproved claims about safety.
